whoItsFor: Developers and teams who run several coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and others) and want one persistent terminal workspace to manage them, including over SSH.
useCases: Keep long-running coding agents alive after closing the client or losing an SSH connection
Monitor multiple agent panes and see which ones are working, blocked, or idle
Let agents spawn panes and prompt each other through the CLI and socket API
